info.name: BoiAro API
info.description:
Complete API documentation for BoiAro v2 — REST + tRPC endpoints.

**Base URL:** `{{baseUrl}}` (e.g. `http://localhost:3001`)

**Auth:** All protected endpoints require `Authorization: Bearer {{access_token}}`

**tRPC protocol:**
- Queries → `GET /trpc/{router}.{procedure}?input={"json":{...}}`
- Mutations → `POST /trpc/{router}.{procedure}` with body `{"json":{...}}`

request.description:
Register a new user account.

**Response 201:** `{ message: "Signup successful. Please verify your email." }`

**Errors:** 400 missing fields · 409 email already registered · 422 password too short

request.description:
Upload a profile photo. Works for both **regular users** and **creators** (all role types share the Profile table).

**Storage behaviour:**
- S3 configured + healthy → uploads to `avatars/` folder on S3
- S3 configured but down → saves locally, **queued for auto-sync** to S3 when it recovers
- S3 not configured → saves locally, **queued for auto-sync** when S3 credentials are added later

The profile's `avatar_url` is automatically updated in the database after upload.

**Response 201:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Profile image uploaded",
  "avatar_url": "https://s3.../avatars/uuid.jpg",
  "storage": "s3"
}
```

`storage` is `"s3"` or `"local"`. When `"local"`, the image will be auto-migrated to S3 in the background.
**Response:** `[{ role: "user" | "writer" | "narrator" | "publisher" | "admin" }]`

formdata.description: JPEG / PNG / WebP / GIF / SVG — max 5 MB

request.description:
General image upload for admin panel (book covers, banners, author/narrator/publisher avatars).

**`type` param:** `avatar` → `avatars/` · `cover` → `covers/` · `image` → `images/`

**Storage:** S3 with local fallback + auto-sync queue (same as profile upload).

**Response:** `{ url: "https://...", via: "s3" | "local" }`

formdata.description: MP3 / AAC / OGG / WAV / EPUB / PDF — max 500 MB

request.description:
Upload large media files for books.

Auto-detects folder: `audio/` for audio files · `ebooks/` for EPUB/PDF

**Response:** `{ url: "https://...", via: "s3" | "local" }`

Server and storage health status.

**Response:**
```json
{
  "status": "ok",
  "timestamp": "2026-05-22T...",
  "storage": "s3" | "local",
  "s3Circuit": "closed" | "open" | "half-open",
  "pendingSyncFiles": 3
}
```

`pendingSyncFiles` = number of local files awaiting S3 sync.

request.description:
Update user/creator profile fields. Used by all creator role panels (writer/narrator/publisher).

Note: Does NOT update `avatar_url` — use `POST /api/v1/profile/upload-image` to change the photo.

All fields optional. Additional fields vs `auth.updateProfile`: `full_name`, `genre`, `specialty`, `experience`, `portfolio_url`.

item.name: tRPC — Admin
item.description:
Admin-only procedures. Require a user with `admin` role.

**Queries:** GET `?input={"json":{...}}` | **Mutations:** POST body `{"json":{...}}`

request.description:
Search for users to link to an author/narrator/publisher profile.

`query`: min 2 chars — matches email, display name, phone.

**IMPORTANT:** Was previously defined as `.query` (GET) but client called it as POST, causing "Unsupported POST-request" error. Now correctly defined as `.mutation` — must be called as POST.
`creatorType`: `author` | `narrator` | `publisher`

Update the linked creator record for the authenticated creator user.

`role`: `writer` | `narrator` | `publisher`

For avatar: first upload via `POST /upload?type=avatar`, then pass the returned URL here.

{
  "json": {
    "name": "লেখকের নাম",
    "name_en": "Author Name",
    "bio": "Author biography.",
    "avatar_url": "https://s3.../avatars/uuid.jpg",
